Follow renames before upstream requirements until reaching a temperature threshold. Inspection is required exactly when deployment temperature is numerically lower than the threshold: deployment_temperature < threshold. Compare signed integers on the number line; for example, -6 is not lower than -11 (NO), while -12 is lower than -5 (YES). Return exactly one line and no explanation: ANSWER|terminal_entity|integer_threshold|YES_or_NO|comma_separated_ordered_record_ids. The provenance field contains record IDs beginning r_, in traversal order, never entity IDs. If the threshold or any required path evidence is absent, return exactly UNKNOWN.
